treatments.healthy: Optimal plant vigor detected. Continue standard drip irrigation and balanced nitrogen-phosphorus-potassium nutrition.
treatments.bacterial_spot: Prune symptomatic leaves. Apply copper bactericides during damp weather and avoid overhead sprinkler watering.
treatments.early_blight: Remove lower infected foliage. Apply chlorothalonil or copper-based fungicides; mulch soil to prevent spore splash.
treatments.late_blight: High urgency: isolate infected plants immediately. Apply systemic fungicides (mancozeb/cymoxanil) and destroy severely wilted crops.
treatments.leaf_mold: Improve greenhouse airflow and lower relative humidity below 85%. Treat with bio-fungicides like Bacillus subtilis.
treatments.septoria_leaf_spot: Strip infected lower foliage, sanitize pruning shears, and apply preventative organic neem or copper sprays.
treatments.spider_mites: Spray with cold water blast or apply horticultural neem oil / insecticidal soap directly to leaf undersides.
treatments.target_spot: Ensure adequate spacing for light penetration; apply azoxystrobin or protective contact fungicides.
treatments.yellow_leaf_curl: Vector-borne viral infection spread by whiteflies. Use yellow sticky traps, insect netting, and rogue infected plants.
treatments.mosaic_virus: Viral pathology with no cure. Remove and burn infected specimens immediately; disinfect all garden tools.
treatments.scab: Clear leaf litter around tree base. Spray wettable sulfur or captan at bud break and petal fall.
treatments.black_rot: Prune mummified fruit and dead wood. Spray myclobutanil early in the growing season.
treatments.cedar_apple_rust: Remove nearby wild juniper/cedar galls within 500m. Apply immunox or protective rust fungicides.
treatments.powdery_mildew: Apply potassium bicarbonate or sulfur spray. Ensure at least 6 hours of direct sunlight and canopy thinning.
treatments.rust: Apply triazole or strobilurin fungicides; plant rust-resistant hybrid seed varieties.
treatments.leaf_scorch: Deep water during dry spells; apply potassium-rich fertilizer and protect from harsh midday winds.
